newsitem.title: CANADA: CanWest says Network TEN talk is rumor.
newsitem.headline: CanWest says Network TEN talk is rumor.

text.p: A report the Australian government may force CanWest Global Communications Corp to sell its stake in Network Ten Ltd is unfounded, CanWest's executive vice president told Reuters.
"It's a rumor. There's nothing to substantiate that," CanWest executive vice president Tom Strike said.
CanWest owns 15 percent of Network TEN's voting interests and a 76 percent economic stake in Network TEN, Strike said.
An Australian newspaper reported on Wednesday that Australia's government had agreed in principle to adopt tougher foreign investment rules in media.
The report said CanWest would be pressured to reduce its economic stake in Network TEN to 15 percent.
